articles.title: AI agents make 138 million crypto payments as U.S. dominates spending on AI models
articles.snippet: U.S.-linked wallets account for just over 88% of tracked AI model payments, dwarfing China’s 0.1% share, according to new Chainalysis research.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward to become first crypto firm to buy a EU bank as it expands into deposits, lending
articles.snippet: Payward agreed to buy Lithuania’s Saldo Bank, which holds $190 million in total assets, securing an EU license for deposits and lending.

articles.title: Bitcoin climbs toward $84,000 after Fed’s Williams sees no rate hikes in 2027
articles.snippet: ZEC led a broad bounce among major tokens, and Korean chipmakers snapped a five-day losing streak ahead of Thursday’s U.S. inflation data.

articles.title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, Bitget offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
articles.snippet: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.

articles.title: ‘Bunker mode’ won’t protect your crypto, critics say
articles.snippet: Even if Justin Drake’s prediction that AI could break cryptography proves correct, critics say “bunker mode” is an impractical suggestion that’s unlikely to protect your crypto.
